meta.title: Fyntic - AI Agency Webflow Template
meta.description: Modern Webflow template for AI agencies, AI startups, technology companies, automation businesses. Dark space-themed UI with blue accents, fully responsive, CMS-ready.
meta.primary_font: Likely Inter or similar modern sans (confirm via DevTools)

typography.notes: Large bold headlines, clean readable body. High contrast white on dark.

spacing_and_layout.notes: Generous section padding, centered content max-widths, card grids with consistent gaps. Pill-shaped nav and buttons common.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Large rounded (pills for nav/CTAs, rounded cards ~12-16px+)

effects.glow: Strong blue radial glows and particle/star field backgrounds
effects.illustrations: 3D AI elements: glowing orb, human/robot hands reaching to central AI sphere, particle effects

section.name: Navigation
section.description: Top nav: Logo (Fyntic. with blue icon) left. Center pill-shaped dark nav bar with links (Home, Pages, Services, Projects, Contact). Right: Sign in / Register text + blue "Get Started" pill button.

section.name: Hero
section.description: Deep space/dark bg with subtle stars/particles. Centered badge "New Automated AI Agent Service". Massive white heading "The #1 AI Agent for All your Customer Services". Subtext. Dual CTAs: white outline "See Pricing Plans" + solid blue "Get In Touch". Avatar group + "Trusted by over +5K People in the Multiverse". Feature tags/pills below (Custom AI Solutions, Scalable Intelligence, etc. with checkmarks). Central 3D illustration of human and robot hands touching a glowing blue AI orb/sphere with rings.
section.key_visual: Glowing blue core with orbital rings, particle effects, hands reaching in.

section.name: Services / Features
section.description: Sections for AI Strategy & Consulting, AI Content Creation, AI Agent Development, AI Process Automation. Card grid with icons, titles, short descriptions, "Read More" links. Dark cards with subtle borders/glows.

section.name: Social Proof / Logos
section.description: Logo strip "Join Over 1500+ Businesses Already Growing With Fyntic" with Logoipsum style logos.

section.name: Additional
section.description: Further sections for projects, pricing, testimonials, team, blog/CMS, contact form. Consistent dark theme with blue accents and modern card-based layouts.

section.name: Footer
section.description: Multi-column footer matching dark theme, logo, links, socials, copyright.

responsive_breakpoints.desktop: Wide layouts, large hero illustration, multi-col grids
responsive_breakpoints.mobile: Single column stack, full-width CTAs, simplified nav

design_audit.recreation_notes: - Primary blue #1452fc / #4476ff. - Near-black bg #040208. - Heavy use of blue glows, particles, 3D AI imagery. - Pill-shaped interactive elements. - High-contrast white text. - For exact match: extract full CSS variables and computed styles from live page; use Webflow or recreate with similar modern AI aesthetic. - Animations: subtle particle movement, glow pulses, scroll reveals.
